A quiet place to live beautifully

Maison Calista is an exclusive boutique residence near Marrakech — twelve rooms, Atlas views, warm daily support, and a life filled with light, culture, and care.

Welcome

Living with warmth, dignity, and quality of life

Founded on years of experience accompanying vulnerable people, Maison Calista offers a calm Moroccan setting where residents enjoy personal space, attentive support, and a rich daily rhythm — far from the isolation often felt in northern Europe.

With only twelve rooms, we are intentionally small. Every resident is known by name, every day has structure and beauty, and every family remains part of the conversation. This is not a clinical institution — it is a home shaped for elegance, comfort, and peace of mind.

Why Maison Calista

Everything that makes a stay exceptional

Only 12 rooms

An intimate residence with a human scale — never crowded, always personal. Admission is managed through a waiting list.

Near Marrakech

Close enough for culture and medical access, peaceful enough for true rest. The medina, museums, and specialist care are within reach.

Atlas Mountain views

Panoramic outlooks from the residence, gardens, and pool across the Moroccan landscape — snow-capped peaks on clear days.

Heated swimming pool

Year-round swimming with views of the Atlas — over 300 sunny days a year make outdoor living part of everyday life.

Personal support

A dedicated daily team for daily living, wellbeing, and peace of mind — preserving independence with warmth and discretion.

Activities & outings

Nature, culture, crafts, cooking, wellbeing, creativity, and gentle adventure — a full programme included in your stay.

On-site restaurant

Moroccan, French, and Italian cuisine — three cuisines, a thousand flavours, prepared daily by our chef.

Family visits

Stay connected with loved ones — video calls, scheduled visits, and generous family stays with meals and transfers included.

Your stay

A gentle transition to a new chapter

Each room offers 40 m² of living space, a 25 m² private terrace, and 65 m² of personal space in total — generous, elegant, and entirely your own.

Admission is by waiting list, allowing a calm, considered transition into residence life. Choose a three-month Discovery Stay to experience Maison Calista with no obligation, or select a longer Well-Being, Comfort, or Signature package tailored to your needs.

A different quality of life

Sunshine where northern winters feel long

Our founder has accompanied vulnerable people and their families since 2008. Regular journeys to Morocco revealed a striking contrast with elderly life in France and Belgium: here, light is abundant, human warmth is natural, and daily life can be rich with colour, culture, and outdoor beauty.

Maison Calista was created as a thoughtful alternative — a place where residents wake to sunshine, share meals prepared with care, and take part in activities that nourish body and spirit.
